name: Issue 7728: the Runic specialization learns Branded at level 50
contract: Branded 707717 is the Runic specialization's level 50 Engravement node after Power Overwhelming 707876:
'Gaining Power Overwhelming now also guarantees your next Runic Brand to critically strike.' This fork's
CharacterAdvancement.dbc lacks the node; the bindmysoul CoA Build Hub snapshot of 2026-07-22 lists it as
32-85-10-8, a free passive at level 50 that depends on Power Overwhelming. A Runic Runemaster learns it on
reaching level 50, while a level 49 Runic Runemaster and a level 50 Runemaster without the specialization
do not. Power Overwhelming's trigger 560051 lasts only with Branded, for 6 sec at 100% crit chance. Each
trial casts Runic Brand, Runeblade and Runic Brand again 2.6 sec later, inside its cooldown, so the second
cast lands only after a reset. At level 49, where Runic Brand damage 712322 has no crit chance, no Runic
Brand crits; at level 50 every reset Runic Brand crits. Thirty trials at 35% give 1 to 23 resets outside a
